$comment: A second game, as data. Both deployments execute a three-module closure over the same Python-built map resource; their registrations remain distinct because each plugin id and entry module bytes are distinct.

deployments.name: expedition
deployments.plugin_justification: umbraflow-declarative-workflow-tool/v1 declares one const tool_name over a fixed states/steps schedule of wait and ui_action states. It has no effects member, so the per-tool OP:PlanProposal effect sets this deployment proposes (distinct scope_key and risk per camp) cannot be declared, and it has no reduce semantics at all, so folding expedition.advanced/arrived/blocked Journal entries into ProjectState has no declarative spelling.
deployments.$comment: The one observed instance this deployment mints is the expedition's target control, admitted by the identity schema it registers here.

deployments.name: rival
deployments.plugin_justification: The same reason as the expedition deployment, and it is not shared: umbraflow-declarative-workflow-tool/v1 has no effects member and no reduce semantics, so this second registration's plan proposals and its Journal fold cannot be declared either. What makes it a separate plugin rather than a second declaration is the plugin_id every proposal is judged under.
deployments.$comment: The one observed instance this deployment mints is the expedition's target control, admitted by the identity schema it registers here.
